source_features.name: Bodrum
source_features.note: Used instead of raw natural=coastline ways for the Bodrum peninsula: OSM admin relations are already valid, correctly-oriented closed multipolygons, unlike raw coastline ways which need noding and directional land/water classification.

source_features.name: Kos
source_features.note: 19 outer member ways, all tagged natural=coastline, merged into one closed ring.

General coastline fetch used only for the ~470 small surrounding islands, via unary_union-based noding + polygonize (see scripts/ingest/fetch_bodrum_kos_osm.py). Bodrum and Kos themselves came from the admin relations above, not this fetch.

sanity_checks_passed: Bodrum peninsula interior classifies as land
Point south of Krio burnu (cape) classifies as water
Kos island interior classifies as land
Bodrum-Kos channel midpoint classifies as water
Gulluk Bay interior classifies as land
Open sea south of Kos classifies as water
validation.engine_smoke_test: services/routing water_graph builds successfully against this geometry and finds a correct channel-crossing route (see git history / conversation log for the one-off benchmark).

known_limitations: Bathymetry is supplied by the separate data/manifests/bodrum_kos_bathymetry.json layer at approximately 115 m resolution; it cannot resolve every near-shore hazard.

OSM/OpenSeaMap physical hazards are supplied by data/manifests/bodrum_kos_marine_features.json. Official managed areas and unresolved notices are tracked separately. Marina, harbour, and explicit marine-fuel POIs are supplied by data/manifests/bodrum_kos_marine_pois.json.
Community-mapped OSM coastline, not an official hydrographic chart. Still not navigation-grade (CLAUDE.md Section 45).
data_note: Real OpenStreetMap-derived coastline for Bodrum peninsula, Kos island, and ~470 surrounding islets. EMODnet DTM bathymetry, hazards, official managed areas/notices, and marine POIs are tracked in separate manifests. Incomplete legal boundaries, coarse bathymetry, and community-data limitations keep confidence LOW.
